posts.en:
dsh-pocket is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ffc905da5f4166690b1e.html
